versions.subject: feat: updates and enhancements
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\git.exe'
        - '\git-remote-https.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'git.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' clone '
        - 'git-remote-https '
selection_keyword:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Add more suspicious keywords
        - 'exploit'
        - 'Vulns'
        - 'vulnerability'
        - 'RCE'
        - 'RemoteCodeExecution'
        - 'Invoke-'
        - 'CVE-'
        - 'poc-'
        - 'ProofOfConcept'
        # Add more vuln names
        - 'proxyshell'
        - 'log4shell'
        - 'eternalblue'
        - 'eternal-blue'
        - 'MS17-'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\git.exe", "*\\git-remote-https.exe") OR OriginalFileName="git.exe" CommandLine IN ("* clone *", "*git-remote-https *") CommandLine IN ("*exploit*", "*Vulns*", "*vulnerability*", "*RCE*", "*RemoteCodeExecution*", "*Invoke-*", "*CVE-*", "*poc-*", "*ProofOfConcept*", "*proxyshell*", "*log4shell*", "*eternalblue*", "*eternal-blue*", "*MS17-*")
